exposure: Maternal, infant, and young child nutrition (MIYCN) services
cohort: Nursing staff in the department of Obstetrics and Gynecology and Pediatrics of RIMS, Ranchi, Jharkhand
finding: While nursing staff provided MIYCN services during various stages, their technical knowledge and skills on specific components were not always in accordance with standard guidelines.
mod_finding: The practice of early initiation of breastfeeding was significantly higher in those who delivered normally (79%) than those by cesarean section (7%).
followup_time: Infants below 6 months of age, children >6 months old
